critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx:227-236 — order memo correctly floats 'attention' to the top and then floats 'emergency' above it ONLY when active_sos.length>0 OR vault_expiring.length>0. Clean, testable, and matches the review request. Confirmed by y-position ordering (Emergency=324, Attention=444 with protectdemo seed; Emergency y flips back down when neither SOS nor expiring exist for other accounts).

index.tsx:529-547 — SectionHead now accepts an optional `badge` numeric prop and renders a coral badge (backgroundColor: c.error) with 9+ overflow. Nice touch, but a11y-wise the badge is not exposed as an accessibilityLabel — a screen reader reads only the title. Low priority, add accessibilityLabel={`${title}, ${badge} needing attention`} on SectionHeadLeft if you want it.

index.tsx:583-609 — AttentionSection: colored left-accent border via borderLeftColor: color plus a 25%-alpha borderColor (`color + '40'`) is a great subtle affordance; iconChip is `color + '1F'` (~12% tint). Rows have testID `attn-{key}` — good hooks for automation.

index.tsx:1109-1135 — EmergencySection: urgent state adds borderColor '#E86A6A' + borderWidth 1.5 AND darkens the text to '#C74B4B'. High-contrast, reads as urgent. Icon flips from medkit → warning when SOS is live.

family.tsx — member cards, helper cards, invite card, Care Team CTA and Send Love CTA all use the same rounded card treatment with subtle borderColor/shadow — visually consistent at 390px, none overflowed. Manage sheet's ROLE segmented control still exposes 3 tiers (role-parent/role-child/role-adult) with active pill in c.brand + light tint — matches the polished styling.

chat/[id].tsx:408 — bubble style now applies borderWidth 1 + borderColor c.border ONLY for `!mine` (other-person) messages while keeping borderWidth:0 for own messages. Combined with the `lineHeight: 21` on the message AppText (line 506), it makes long messages calmer/more readable without changing the coral 'mine' look. Verified in DOM.

chat/[id].tsx:838 — bubble base style (minWidth:60, borderRadius:radius.md, paddingHorizontal:spacing.md, paddingVertical:spacing.sm) is unchanged; only the border-on-others addition is new. Reactions chip below still renders with its own border, no double-border artifact.
